_comment: G2 scale-up ladder: 12/14/16 physical qubits, outcome-only. Measured on apollo, CuPy holds ~9 accepted labels/s flat across this range while NumPy falls from 2.77 to 0.09 (103x at 16 qubits), so this config is meant to be generated with --backend cupy. A full spectral teacher is impossible here (capped at 10) and is not needed: the frontier instrument re-searches controls from scratch.
